title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Mobile-Solutions-Architecture-Designer exam
question:
Universal Containers manages a catalog of overone million products that it makes available to its customers.
The master product catalog is stored and managed in their ERP application with frequent updates made to the product catalog by their sourcing team. The sourcing team may update attributes suchas price, general catalog availability, and the product description. When the sourcing team makes an update that change must go into effect during the next business day and there may be thousands of changes made over the course of the day.
What integration pattern would you recommend to best manage this scenario?
option_A: Write an outbound message to send productchanges in real time from ERP.
option_B: Build a scheduled ETL job to sync products on a nightly basis from ERP.
option_C: Use the streaming API to receive product changes in real time from ERP.
option_D: Write a custom web service to accept product catalog changes from ERP.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Mobile-Solutions-Architecture-Designer exam
question: Universal Containers would like to display data from an external system inside of Salesforce, and has chosen not to enable lightning Experience. They do not need the data for any other purposes within Salesforce.Which approach should an Integration Architect recommend that matches the Salesforce UI?Choose 2 answers
option_A: A custom Visualforce page with client- side calls out to the other systems.
option_B: An iFrame embedding a custom .Net application that displays data from the other systems.
option_C: A middleware orchestration to continuously persist data from other systems into Salesforce.
option_D: A custom visualforce page with a controller thats calls-out to the other systems.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Mobile-Solutions-Architecture-Designer exam
question: Universal Containers has built an integration using the SOAP API to load records from a back-office system into Salesforce. The records created in the back-office system must be loaded into Salesforce in almost real time, so a custommodule was written to identify CRUD events in the back-office system and perform sync with Salesforce. UC has several other systems that integrate with Salesforce through the SOAP API using separate integration users.What is a risk involved with this sort of integration?
option_D: Reaching a logins per Day limit.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Mobile-Solutions-Architecture-Designer exam
question: Universal Containers sells its products online using a system built on Force.com sites. The orders are captures and processed in Salesforce. the company uses an external marketing system and would like to make use of the customer data captured in Salesforce.The marketing system has REST API that can be used to push data into it.Which three options should a Technical Architect consider that do not require building custom web services on the marketing system?Choose 3 answers
option_A: Use a middleware tool to pull customer data from Salesforce and push it to the marketing system on adaily basis.
option_B: Build a custom java application using the Enterprise WSDL to pull data from Salesforce and push it to the marketing system.
option_C: Write a custom Apex web service, Which will be called from the marketing system to retrieve customer data.
option_D: Use Apex callout to send customer data from Salesforce to the marketing system
option_E: Use outbound messages to send customer data from Salesforce to the marketing system.
